note: Reference answers for the DocGraph repository itself (schema v3). keywords are scored case-insensitively against the answer; symbols are the definitions a search should surface.

questions.question: Where is community detection implemented, and which indexer method runs it?
questions.reference: docgraph/communities.py defines detect() (Louvain via networkx). Indexer._recompute_communities in docgraph/index.py calls it after PageRank and writes Community + MEMBER_OF through GraphDB.replace_communities.

questions.question: Which function decodes SCIP protobuf index files?
questions.reference: decode_index in docgraph/scip.py, a dependency-free protobuf wire-format reader (_fields / _varint).

questions.question: Where are the Kuzu table definitions and the schema version constant defined?
questions.reference: docgraph/db.py: NODE_DDL and EDGE_DDL lists, SCHEMA_VERSION, applied by GraphDB.init_schema (+ migrate).

questions.question: How is a cooperative cancel checked during indexing?
questions.reference: CancelToken.raise_if_set in docgraph/cancel.py raises OperationCancelled; Indexer.index_all calls it via its _ck helper between phases and _stream_embed_insert checks it per batch.

questions.question: Which functions call GraphDB.insert_edges?
questions.reference: Indexer.index_all, Indexer._write_similar_edges, Indexer._recompute_similar_partial, Indexer._write_co_changed, Indexer._write_tests_edges, GraphDB.replace_communities and scip.maybe_ingest.

questions.question: What calls parse_file?
questions.reference: _parse_worker in docgraph/index.py (run in the process pool by Indexer.index_all), plus parser tests.

questions.question: Which Retriever methods use the confidence-filtered BFS helper _bfs_calls?
questions.reference: call_graph, _callers_rows (impact_of with min_confidence), test_impact, _flow_for (processes / flow), context, _tests_for, detect_changes, route_map and api_impact.

questions.question: What would be affected by changing Workspace.take_writer?
questions.reference: The /api/admin/index route (api_admin_index -> _do) and the watcher reindex paths in docgraph/watch.py (_reindex / _baseline_reindex), plus workspace and job tests.

questions.question: Which HTTP routes and MCP tools depend on Retriever.search?
questions.reference: GET /api/search (api_search in server.py) and the MCP `search` tool in mcp_tools.py; context() also uses it for suggestions (GET /api/context).

questions.question: Trace the call path from the POST /api/admin/index route to the PageRank computation.
questions.reference: api_admin_index -> _do -> Indexer.index_all -> Indexer._recompute_tier4 -> compute_pagerank (docgraph/rank.py), then write_pagerank.

questions.question: What happens when an MCP client calls the `search` tool?
questions.reference: mcp_tools.search resolves the root slot and calls Retriever.search: query embedding (Embedder.embed_query), chunk max-similarity, BM25 (_bm25_for) fused with RRF (rrf_fuse), PageRank / personalized PageRank boost, optional cross-encoder rerank.

questions.question: What are the main components of DocGraph and how do they interact?
questions.reference: CLI (cli.py) starts the host; Workspace holds per-root read-only Kuzu connections and Retrievers; Indexer (index.py) parses with tree-sitter (parse.py), resolves edges (resolve.py), embeds (embed.py) and writes Kuzu (db.py); server.py serves REST + the FastMCP tools from mcp_tools.py; the UI is ui/index.html.

questions.question: How does the shared embedding daemon relate to the Embedder class?
questions.reference: docgraph/daemon.py runs one warm model; Embedder.embed routes through _maybe_embed_via_daemon -> embed_via_daemon when client mode is configured (configure_client at host start), falling back to in-process embedding.

questions.question: Which tests cover the read-only Cypher guard?
questions.reference: The test_cypher_* tests in tests/test_new_tools.py and the cypher write-blocker tests in tests/test_api.py.

questions.question: Which tests should run after changing the call-resolution cascade in resolve.py?
questions.reference: tests/test_graph_features.py (resolution tiers, ambiguity candidates, receivers) plus the indexer / retrieval suites that depend on CALLS edges (tests/test_indexer.py, tests/test_retrieval.py, tests/test_new_tools.py).
